name: United Club Card

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not explicitly stated on product page.

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles redeemable via MileagePlus program for United flights and partner awards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 80,000 bonus miles after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Unlimited United Club access for you and a guest
benefits.description: Your card includes United Club card membership — a $750+ value. Plus, unlock All Access membership when you reach Premier Gold status or spend $50,000 annually. Starting with your first anniversary, earn 4 United Club one-time passes when you have United Club All Access Membership and an authorized user.

benefits.title: Free first and second checked bags
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and one companion can each check a first and second standard bags for free - save up to $440 per roundtrip.

benefits.title: Premier Access travel services
benefits.description: Receive preferential treatment to ease your way through the airport with priority check-in, security screening, boarding, and baggage handling privileges (where available).

benefits.title: 10,000-mile award flight discount
benefits.description: Earn a 10,000-mile award flight discount after $20,000 in purchases to use toward an eligible award flight - up to two times each calendar year.

benefits.title: Up to $200 in credits annually (Renowned Hotels and Resorts)
benefits.description: Receive up to $200 back in statement credits each anniversary year on prepaid hotel stays purchased directly through Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers.

benefits.title: Up to $150 in credits on rideshare purchases
benefits.description: Enroll to receive up to $150 back as statement credits each calendar year on rideshare purchases when you pay with your United Club Card.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in United travel credits (Avis/Budget)
benefits.description: Receive up to $100 in United travel credits annually when you book Avis or Budget car rentals directly through cars.united.com and pay with your United Club Card.

benefits.title: Up to $240 in Instacart credits each calendar year
benefits.description: Receive up to $240 in Instacart credits each calendar year for purchases made directly through Instacart. Terms apply.

benefits.title: Up to $200 in credits annually on JSX
benefits.description: Receive up to $200 in credits annually on flights purchased directly through JSX with your United Club Card.

benefits.title: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles
benefits.description: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles. Premier members save even more.

benefits.title: 1,500 Card Bonus PQP each year
benefits.description: Get a jump start on earning Premier status with 1,500 Card Bonus Premier qualifying points (PQP) each year. Awarded within 8 weeks of February 1.

benefits.title: Earn PQP on purchases
benefits.description: Earn 1 Premier Qualifying Point (PQP) for every $15 spent on purchases with your Club Card.

lounge_access.notes: Unlimited United Club access for cardmember and guest ($750+ value)

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free first and second checked bags for primary cardmember and one companion (save up to $440 per roundtrip)

notes: Verified against official Chase product page 2026-07-24. Name updated to 'United Club Card'. APR 19.74%-28.24% variable confirmed. Annual fee $695 confirmed. Signup bonus confirmed (80,000 miles after $5,000 in 3 months, plus 10,000 for adding authorized user). FX fee not explicitly stated on page.
